'''Group 2''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of three [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeders]] led by [[Palmer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Palmer]]. Group 2 was a diversionary force formed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="BFN" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> to assist in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|recapture]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. During the battle, they became trapped in a plaza by two [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and two [[P-series droideka/Legends|destroyer droids]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykess]] intervened to rescue the trapped Security Force [[Officer/Legends|officers]], but not before one of Group 2's speeders was lost. Group 2 and Sykes then continued onto their objective, the [[Theed Courthouse]], where [[Group 3]] and a group of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] blew open a gate blocking their way.<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Group 2 appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It is difficult to fight to Group 2 in time to rescue all three, so this article assumes one speeder was lost. If all three speeders are lost, the player, in the role of Sykes, fails the mission.
